ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import p from Mule output text/xml ns soapenv http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/ --- soapenv#Envelope @('xmlns:urn' : 'urn:ETB_Integracion_SF_RMD_Create'): { soapenv#Header: 'urn:AuthenticationInfo' : { 'urn:userName':p('mdm-remedy.credentials.user'), 'urn:password':p('mdm-remedy.credentials.password'), 'urn:authentication':null, 'urn:locale':null, 'urn:timeZone':null, }, soapenv#Body: 'urn:Create': payload..*Create map ((item, index) -> item mapObject ('urn:$$' : $) ) }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var out = payload.Envelope.Body.CreateResponse --- { "Incident_ID": out.OUT_Incident_ID, "Message": out.OUT_Error_Mensaje default "Proceso Completo", "Result": out.Aknowledge }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- vars.outboundHeaders ++ { 'name': 'Mulesoft', 'processingServer': 'Mulesoft MDM', 'status': 'PASS', 'responseDate': now(), 'correlationID': vars.idSalesforce }
